context: Two adults watch a televised parliamentary debate
purpose: Teach: 議席/議員/公務/議論/軍/命/知識/行動

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: おい、テレビをつけてくれ。今夜は国会中継だ。議員たちの本気が見られるぞ。
lines.en: Hey, turn on the TV. Tonight is the Diet broadcast. We can see the Diet members get serious.
lines.style: Gruff older boss giving casual orders at home

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい、つけました。野党が議席を大きく伸ばしたみたいですね。
lines.en: Yes, I turned it on. Looks like the opposition gained a lot of seats.
lines.style: Polite junior office worker responding respectfully to boss

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 見ろ、あの大臣の答弁。軍事力の強化について、ずいぶん歯切れが悪いな。
lines.en: Look at that minister's reply. He's awfully vague about strengthening military power.
lines.style: Skeptical opinionated commentary on politicians from boss

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: ええ、自衛隊員の命を懸ける話ですから、慎重になるのも分かります。
lines.en: Yes, since it's a matter of SDF personnel risking their lives, I understand being cautious.
lines.style: Thoughtful measured viewpoint from younger colleague speaking

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 公務員の給料の話より、もっと活発な議論をしてほしいもんだ。
lines.en: I wish they'd have a more lively debate instead of talking about civil servant salaries.
lines.style: Frustrated older man criticizing political priorities loudly

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: 確かに。専門知識を持った議員がもっと発言すべきだと思います。
lines.en: True. I think Diet members with expert knowledge should speak up more.
lines.style: Agreeable but adding own polite observation respectfully

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 口だけじゃダメだ。実際に行動を起こす政治家が、今の日本には必要なんだよ。
lines.en: Just talk isn't enough. Japan today needs politicians who actually take action.
lines.style: Emphatic declarative statement with conviction and frustration

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: おっしゃる通りです。次の選挙、ちゃんと考えて投票しないといけませんね。
lines.en: You're absolutely right. We have to think carefully and vote in the next election.
lines.style: Reflective closing agreement with civic seriousness throughout
